name.my: မုန့်ဟင်းခါး ဟင်းရည်

method: Poach the fish with lemongrass and turmeric, flake it. Fry onion, garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil, add the fish, stock, banana stem, toasted rice flour and chickpea flour; simmer until thick.
notes: Drafted by Claude from general knowledge (2026-11-01); not yet checked against published recipes. Lemongrass: outer stalks are taken out, so 30 % is counted.
